quote: We compare the performance of Phrase-BERT against baselines on a variety of phrases tasks involving phrases of different length and types.
We implement the word intrusion task by giving crowd workers a list of six words or phrases and asking them to choose which one does not belong with the rest.

Following , we perform two different sets of human evaluation experiments on Amazon Mechanical Turk: (1) word intrusion, which measures topic coherence, and (2) topic-to-document relatedness, which evaluates whether a topic assigned to a document is actually relevant.
guideline: Workers are presented with a list of words/phrases (or two topics and a passage) and asked to select the intruder (or the topic that best matches the passage).
Workers are asked to choose which word or phrase does not belong in a list of six (word intrusion), and to select which of two topics best matches a given passage (topic-to-document relatedness).
